## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle verse treatise (*kārikā* + brief auto-commentary) by [陳那菩薩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B3%E9%82%A3%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9) **Dignāga** (c. 480–540), translated into Chinese by [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) (Xuánzàng) in the early Táng. The standard Cí'ēn-school recension of Dignāga's *Ālambana-parīkṣā*; the second of two extant Chinese translations after [KR6n0111](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0111) *Wúxiāng sīchén lùn* by [真諦](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E8%AB%A6) (Paramārtha). Preserved in the *Taishō* at T31n1624. The Xuánzàng translation became the standard reference text for the work in the Sino-Japanese Yogācāra tradition.

**Abstract**

Dignāga's argument runs in two stages: (1) the atom is not the *ālambana* because the perceived characteristic is not the atom's characteristic; (2) the aggregate is not the *ālambana* because, lacking real essence, it cannot serve as the *cause* of the perceptual image; therefore the *ālambana* must be the internal cognitive form (*nèisè* 內色 / *nèishí xiāngfēn* 內識相分) that arises within consciousness itself. This is the canonical Yogācāra argument for the *vijñapti-mātratā* (*wéishì* 唯識) doctrine in its epistemological formulation.

The Xuánzàng translation is doctrinally somewhat tighter than Paramārtha's parallel [KR6n0111](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0111) *Wúxiāng sīchén lùn*: the technical vocabulary is fully assimilated to Cí'ēn-school usage (*suǒyuányuán* for *ālambana-pratyaya*, *jíwēi* for *paramāṇu*, *xiāngfēn* for *ākāra* / *nimitta*), and the verses are presented in their canonical eight-verse form. The translation date is conventionally set in **Xiǎnqìng 2 = 657** at *Cí'ēnsì* during Xuánzàng's productive Yogācāra-translation campaign.

The Xuánzàng version is the platform for the entire late-imperial Chinese commentary tradition: [KR6n0113](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0113) *Guān suǒyuán lùn shì* by Dharmapāla / Yìjìng (T31n1625), [KR6n0114](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0114) *Huìshì* by [明昱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E6%98%B1), [KR6n0115](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0115) *Zhíjiě* by [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD), [KR6n0116](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0116) *Shìjì* by [明昱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E6%98%B1), [KR6n0117](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0117) *Shì zhíjiě* by [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) all derive from this recension.
